$comment: Ordered implementation schedule compiled from SPEC.md. WIP=1: only ONE feature may be 'in_progress' at a time. A feature moves to 'passing' only when every listed verification actually ran and passed. Statuses: not_started | in_progress | blocked | passing.

features.title: Observer modes and audited unblinding
features.user_visible_behavior: Clean spectators remain blind, researchers may explicitly unblind with a permanent audit mark and benchmark-ineligibility warning, and completed matches support post-match reveal.
features.evidence: The focused observer UI, real-ledger mode, browser stream projection, and configured-run suites passed 15 of 15 cases. A controller observer-mode hexagon derives Clean, unblinded, and post-match reveal state from the append-only ledger; operator-only bodyless unblinding appends one idempotent public observer_unblinded event, permanently sets benchmark eligibility false, survives restart, and is also emitted when an unblinded disclosure policy is selected at creation. Browser SSE and artifact adapters mark requests as Observatory reads, so the controller uses durable observer perspective even when the same in-memory operator credential controls the run; direct operator infrastructure reads remain separate. Clean reads cannot resolve participant-private/covert evidence, unblinded reads can, post-match reveal unlocks permitted research evidence without exposing operator-private data, and newly visible history is rebuilt from stream start. The UI distinguishes Clean spectator, Unblinded researcher, and Post-match reveal, with a two-step permanent-audit and benchmark-disqualification warning. Desktop and 390px inspection verified the Clean, confirmation, and unblinded states with zero horizontal overflow. Production Vite bundling passed. Final make check passed the 350-line guard, ESLint, six strict workspace typechecks, 54 test files, and 341 tests.
features.notes: AC 15 and 16.

features.title: Portable deterministic replay
features.user_visible_behavior: A completed or cancelled run exports a portable bundle that reconstructs the synchronized timeline, artifacts, beliefs, governance, reveal, and metrics without a model, Docker, provider, or network call.
verification: corepack pnpm vitest run packages/protocol/src/replay-bundle.test.ts packages/core/src/replay.test.ts apps/controller/src/replay/replay.integration.test.ts apps/web/src/replay/replay.test.tsx
features.evidence: The focused replay contract, pure core projector, real SQLite/artifact export, and browser suites passed 16 of 16 cases. A controller replay hexagon requires a configured completed or cancelled run, derives its durable observer perspective server-side, omits operator-private events and raw ledger sequences, renumbers only visible deliveries, embeds every referenced authorized artifact, and fails rather than emitting a partial bundle. The additive Version 1 bundle parser rejects unknown fields, unsupported versions, gaps, cross-run events, duplicate identities, terminal mismatch, inconsistent observer eligibility, and missing or unreferenced artifacts.
